claims.title: DCR Is Not a Reachability Certificate

findings.rationale: Unsupported citation graph edges and unverified source-reading claims are removed. The bounded reading map identifies actual primary passages and independent examples. The companion source was renamed byte-identically from Markdown at1cfa47d4 to Quarto for default production selection; recorded local source hashes retain their explicit earlier commit provenance.
Regular level-set assumptions, affine moving constraints and non-coordinate basis speeds replace mobility and coordinate conflations; a singular point and rotating frame provide counterexamples.

Independent saddle solves, dual mass-metric projectors and circular trajectories verify curvature-complete drift and reduced reconstruction; the original position DAE is distinguished from acceleration-level equations.

The spring system has rank-one acceleration input but full state controllability. A forward-integrated Gramian control and force-cap impossibility certificate distinguish unrestricted controllability from bounded finite-time reachability.

All seven declared planar coordinates and rotating grip offsets are finite-differenced. Compatible velocity, selected-point stationarity and full task acceleration are distinct. Basis invariance prevents unsupported physiological synergy claims.
Stationary ideal net reaction power, interbody transfer, moving-support work, actuator effort and metabolism are distinguished; unsupported universal golf prescriptions are withdrawn.
Shared TOC active-heading selection remains incorrect although section destinations work. Scientific review does not certify highlighting; the defect is independently tracked.
Corrected the denial of telescoping score accounting; penalties, fixed benchmark/start conditions, category entry and exit terms, and per-round versus per-putt units are explicit.

Separated policy evaluation from optimality and causal identification; replaced universal poor-putter and mean-proximity claims with checked counterexamples, full distributions, joint interventions, state-dependent mixture derivatives and qualified mechanics-to-score links.
Restored visible explanatory panels, textual table headers, readable mobile equations and dark references/cards/takeaways; final rendered checks cover the actual routes and expanded content.
Separate exact all-real-input identities from physically admissible sets and zero-input interventions; derive feasible-reference increments and independently check a bounded scalar example.
Derive the constrained inverse-mass map and curvature bias with explicit mode/rank assumptions; verify independent KKT examples and distinguish reaction covectors from admissible velocities.
Distinguish full state, mechanical acceleration and task maps; keep task bias in total acceleration and verify its cancellation in same-state differences.
Preserve referenced equation tags while removing stray automatic labels and desktop-wide groups; verify416 settled math expressions, four accessibility cases and all21 mobile horizontal scrollers.
Correct both surface-height signs, retain the residual normal couple, distinguish COP from the central axis and COM, and state degenerate cases.
Use correlated first-order uncertainty and explicit pressure/bilateral nonuniqueness examples rather than universal error laws or unsupported channel recovery.
Correct excitation scaling, charge-amplifier droop, tare/impulse error, resonance versus bandwidth and pre-sampling alias prevention; independently check examples.
Identify ASTM F3109-23 public scope and exclusions; preserve model-specific manufacturer conditions and separate patent descriptions from independent validation.
Correct torque range versus peak, force at time versus RFD, coordinate-relative simulation metrics and gait-to-golf extrapolations; retain study populations and frames.
Declare complete external loads and work categories; distinguish contact and COM power, forces and free couples, descriptive patterns and tested interventions.
Bound kinematic and learned estimates by contact closure, reference point, held-out subjects, filtering and task; distinguish offline prediction from causal real-time capability.
Fix the overview expansion selector locally, preserve equation type size, and verify settled themes, complete math rendering and horizontal scroll endpoints.
Correct system boundaries, third-law pairs, vertical signs and acceleration/impulse interpretation; reject a compulsory segment sequence inferred from whole-system balance.
Derive offset COP and free moment, transport wrench power consistently, distinguish material/COP motion and COM kinetic energy, and qualify rolling, deformable and moving support.
Derive input-dependent reactions with explicit rank and contact assumptions; independently check KKT examples and require unilateral/friction and moving-support feasibility for counterfactuals.
Separate net moments from muscle force, observational associations from causal coaching claims, and fitted consistency from held-out prediction with a fair COM baseline.
Correct the Joo, Sturdy and Werling author lists in both bibliographies from primary publication records; preserve other entries and bound dependent carry-forward.
Align both complete editions with eight worked solutions, preserved targets, 118 matching expressions, complete isolated print inspection and settled desktop/mobile math validation.
Signed axial moments, length derivatives, transpose and generalized-speed/contact maps are now derived from virtual work.
Bounded null-space sharing, incompatible joint maxima and state-dependent dynamic reachability replace unconstrained torque/recruitment inference.
Geometric stiffness and signed biarticular power counterexamples separate material stiffness, stability, transfer, absorption and tissue energetics.
Anatomical, optimization and grip claims now state evidence limits, distinguish measured quantities and provide testable hypotheses instead of unsupported universal prescriptions.

Fresh settled navigation reaches the requested heading but highlights a later grip subsection. The relative-offset/document-scroll mismatch is reproduced and tracked separately; scientific review does not certify correct active-section highlighting.
Correct joint-origin constraints, universal-axis geometry, rate/power pairing, coordinate singularities and independent closure rank in both editions.
Separate anatomical angles from laboratory orientation, moving shoulder centers from fixed roots, force coupling from coordinate count, and grip deformation from spatial club roll.
Remove unsupported injury thresholds, direct-measurement attribution, universal wrist-rate and muscle-recruitment claims; distinguish model loads from clinical evidence.
Provide declared 35-velocity and 18-to-12 closure examples and seven worked exercises, including explicit non-identifiability answers.
Align print/web content, split wide displays, fix print overflow and exercise-label duplication; inspect the 18-page print chapter and settled 109-expression mobile/desktop views.
Define drift and input effects as components of a state derivative at fixed state/time; distinguish zero input from muscle relaxation and momentum from force.
Qualify constraint work, stored energy and finite-horizon task authority; remove unsupported universal passivity, control-loss and elite-skill conclusions.
Unify print/web reasoning, connect geometry/contact/muscle/shaft choices, preserve TOC/deep links and verify paired text plus print/browser presentation.
The prior route blurred chapter availability, notebook existence, and model fidelity; the correction pins source bytes, states scaffold limits, and bounds biological inferences.
The route needed an explicit publication state, immutable authority links, notebook limits, and a boundary around the canonical completeness-bearing chapter title.
The prior route omitted canonical chapter 7B and amplified real-time, demonstration, benchmark, and deployability language without validation.

The landing page now distinguishes the two textbooks, governed technical monograph, scaffolded notebooks, source state, and separate software authority without promoting computational evidence to human validation.
The prior roadmap published unsupported hour ranges, mastery and no-background claims, stale chapter counts, and completion language despite scaffolded notebooks.
The prior map omitted canonical chapters 3B and 9 and used unbounded exactness and unification language.

The critique withdraws stationarity, full observation and risk neutrality as accounting requirements, while retaining its governed open identity and the bounded concern about predictive and decision-model adequacy. References and falsification conditions were corrected without silently closing the critique.

A manually constructed interval result could carry an outcome label that contradicted its uncertainty bounds. IntervalDecision now derives the expected classification from the declared minimum effect and rejects contradictory labels.

The biography contained an uncited industrial temperature claim and no boundary between personal experience and scientific authority. The correction removes the irrelevant quantitative claim and adds the boundary.
The page said active development despite containing no review. It now uses the planned state and disclaims a publication commitment.
The page implied active priorities and a prompt personal response. It now routes public work to the tracker and states the acceptance and response boundaries.
The channels resolved but their visibility and non-guarantee boundaries were implicit. The page now states them directly.
The page used formatted references without resolvable links and could make two distinct mechanisms look evidentially equivalent. It now links primary papers and labels the comparison as analogy.

The roadmap contradicted its own live-status rule with stale percentages, deadlines, completion claims, and incorrect engine tiers. It is now an evergreen issue/merge authority map with a pinned support contract.

A series card said ZTCF separates passive dynamics from deliberate torque, exceeding the protected intervention contract. It now describes model-conditioned interventions and rejects unique muscular or intent inference.
The page description called the bounded editorial program a comprehensive theory series. It now identifies the series as editorial without implying exhaustive theoretical coverage.
The wrapper exposed normative definitions without stating that semantic authority is not empirical validation. The new callout makes the boundary explicit.

Mobile browser review found canonical quaternion and vector norm rows malformed and wide reference tables clipped without a local scroll affordance. The canonical rows are repaired and notation tables now scroll within a page-scoped container.

The overview used a nonexistent verification path, wrong REST route and request fields, unpinned main links, and overstated engine support. The corrected example and tiers match protected UpstreamDrift source.

The quick start conflated the package metadata lower bound with open-ended interpreter support by saying Python 3.11 or newer. It now separates requires-python >=3.11 from the tested Python 3.11 and 3.12 minors and explicitly withholds Python 3.13 qualification.

The landing page used comparative superlatives for its reading path and could blur tangent-map linearity with nonlinear flow. The corrected status and locality statement close both amplification paths.

Calling the unified thesis the complete reference manuscript amplified completeness beyond the route's experimental and article-bounded authority. It is now described only as the single-file reference manuscript.

The hub repeated exact percentages, proof language, performance numbers, and causal conclusions from downstream pages whose route audits remain separate. The rewritten hub uses topic summaries and page-specific state boundaries.

The hub advertised proper kinematics, full control, and comprehensive biomechanical visualization without a qualification boundary. It now labels the reduced wrist tools experimental and bounds interpretation.
